'''2010 Dagobah Regionals John Yakulevich LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Yakulevich]] at [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' watch your cookie cutters
* '''Username:''' rancor34
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
